text:
maria.platform: Heads up — during preflight for RC5 airgap we saw checksum mismatches on transport mirror B. Repro across two artifacts. Need packaging + transport ops to triage. Target change window tonight 23:00 UTC. /cc @kevin-sre @alice-packaging

alice-packaging: ack. pulling logs now, probably gzip vs raw tar mismatch. listing artifact hashes.

sam.eng-release: Deploy bot shows signed-manifest version mismatch vs staging. Can we pause the canary? :thinking:

deploy-bot: automated: canary paused for release/rc5 at 1751236789 by deploy-bot. Run `/deploy rollback --manifest=rc5 --to=rc4` to initiate rollback. Logs: https://deploy.internal/1751236789

kevin-sre: @alice-packaging can you confirm signer timestamp and cosign output? If mismatch we should unpin and fallback to rc4. Also open a hotpatch branch.

alice-packaging: cosign OK for primary, secondary mirror had truncated blob; reuploading with SHA256: abcdef1234567890... Estimated re-propagation ~12m. Will push a signed submanifest after.

maria.platform: timeline: if reupload completes before 22:45 UTC we can proceed; else we rollback. Who owns the rollback run? @sam.eng-release

sam.eng-release: I can run rollback. prefer to let you finish reupload if within 15m. I'll standby. :thumbsup:

kevin-sre: Also enabling autoswitch fallback in routing policy to avoid customer-facing failures. Patch pushed: `routing.policy.fallback=rc4` — rolling now.

deploy-bot: action log: canary resume blocked until `manifest-signed` event. Tagging thread with `deploy:hotpatch`.

ops-oncall: FYI tracking incident INC-2026-0423 for visibility. If rollback triggers, will coordinate postmortem.

alice-packaging: reupload complete, verifying hashes: SHA256 matches on both mirrors. Pushing signed submanifest now.

maria.platform: confirm when you publish signed submanifest and I'll instruct deploy-bot to continue canary.

alice-packaging: published submanifest 1751237450, cosign sig attached.

deploy-bot: automated: manifest-signed event received at 1751237451. Resuming canary for rc5 with staged 10% traffic. Monitor logs and metrics.

sam.eng-release: monitoring :eyes: Will abort and rollback if error rate >1% in 10m.

kevin-sre: thanks all. Postmortem template assigned to alice-packaging to capture root cause and prevention.

maria.platform: closing thread once canary passes. Great coordination.
